# Numora

Numora is a framework-agnostic numeric input and number input library for JavaScript and React. It solves the fundamental problems with `<input type="number">` - cursor jumping, scientific notation leaking, paste chaos, mobile keyboard issues, and locale-specific decimal/thousand separator conflicts.

## Packages

- **numora** (vanilla JS / any framework): https://www.npmjs.com/package/numora
- **numora-react** (React wrapper): https://www.npmjs.com/package/numora-react

## API Reference - numora (vanilla JS)

All values are strings; Numora never converts them to `Number`.

```ts
import { NumoraInput, FormatOn, ThousandStyle } from 'numora'

const numoraInput = new NumoraInput(containerElement, {
  decimalMaxLength?: number,       // max decimal places (default 2)
  decimalMinLength?: number,       // min decimal places, pads zeros (default 0)
  thousandSeparator?: string,      // default ','
  thousandStyle?: ThousandStyle,   // None (default) | Thousand | Lakh | Wan
  decimalSeparator?: string,       // default '.'
  formatOn?: FormatOn,             // FormatOn.Blur (default) | FormatOn.Change
  locale?: string | true,          // e.g. 'de-DE', or true for the browser locale
  enableCompactNotation?: boolean, // '1k' -> '1000'
  enableNegative?: boolean,
  enableLeadingZeros?: boolean,
  autoAddLeadingZero?: boolean,    // '.5' -> '0.5'
  rawValueMode?: boolean,          // onChange receives the value without separators
  maxLength?: number,              // raw length; separators not counted
  isAllowed?: (rawValue: string) => boolean, // reject an edit by returning false
  onChange?: (value: string) => void,
  value?: string,
  defaultValue?: string,
})

numoraInput.getValue()
numoraInput.setValue('1234.5')
```

Scientific notation (e.g. `1.5e-7`) is always expanded to a plain decimal string.

## API Reference - numora-react

```tsx
import { NumoraInput, FormatOn, ThousandStyle } from 'numora-react'

<NumoraInput
  maxDecimals={2}                        // default 2
  decimalMinLength={0}
  thousandSeparator=","
  thousandStyle={ThousandStyle.Thousand} // default Thousand
  decimalSeparator="."
  formatOn={FormatOn.Change}             // default FormatOn.Blur
  locale="en-US"
  enableNegative={false}
  enableLeadingZeros={false}
  enableCompactNotation={false}
  maxLength={18}
  isAllowed={(raw) => raw !== '0'}
  onChange={(e) => {
    e.target.value          // raw numeric string, e.g. "1234.56"
    e.target.formattedValue // display string, e.g. "1,234.56"
  }}
/>
```

## Common Use Cases

- **DeFi / financial inputs**: prevent scientific notation, enforce decimal precision, expose raw value for smart contract calls
- **International forms**: locale-aware decimal and thousand separators (e.g. German `1.234,56`)
- **React Hook Form integration**: spread `register()` onto `NumoraInput`; `e.target.value` is already the raw value
- **Mobile-safe inputs**: normalises mobile keyboard quirks across iOS and Android
- **Formatted display while typing**: thousand separators added live without breaking cursor position
